create.name: Sarah McCrum
create.bio:
Sarah McCrum is a British-born teacher and author whose subject is the inner side of money: how fear, scarcity and old habits shape the way people earn, spend and give, and how a calmer, more generous relationship with it can change business and family life. Before teaching she spent a decade as a BBC radio reporter, studied at Cambridge and the Mozarteum in Salzburg, and in 2000 opened The Energy Bank, a London training centre for business leaders. Her approach rests on more than twenty years of training in Chinese energy practice.

Her best-known book, Love Money, Money Loves You, began as a message she felt Money itself was dictating to her, and it frames money as a living energy to be befriended rather than chased. Her later book, Energy On Demand, turns to personal energy and working without burning out. She now teaches mostly online through recorded audio activations, short self-paced courses on themes such as working light, releasing karma and opening the heart, a guided money app, and a long-running YouTube channel of talks on soul, purpose and conscious business. Her tone is relaxed and practical, aimed as much at business owners as at spiritual seekers.

books.title: Love Money, Money Loves You: A Conversation With the Energy of Money
books.author: Sarah McCrum
books.description: Written as a dialogue with Money, which speaks for itself as a friendly, connecting energy. It sets out principles for a loving relationship with money and for running a business on generosity rather than fear.

courses.title: Money Love Journey
courses.description: A guided app built on her book, with short audio activations, self-assessments and daily exercises. It is meant for people who want to feel easier and more trusting around money day to day.

courses.title: The Energy of Money
courses.description: A seven-day self-paced mini-course of recorded audio activations and talks. Each day invites you to sense money as energy and notice how your attitude to it changes.

courses.title: Introduction to Working Light
courses.description: A short recorded course on her idea of working light: getting things done from a relaxed, flowing state instead of through effort and strain. It mixes brief teachings with guided activations.

courses.title: Open Your Heart
courses.description: A longer self-paced course of around fifty lessons, including guided relaxations, on feeling more open and connected with yourself and those close to you. It also looks at making peace in relationships.

free_resources.title: Love Money, Money Loves You: first four chapters
free_resources.description: A free ebook sample with the opening four chapters of her best-known book, sent on sign-up. A simple way to meet her voice and ideas before buying.

free_resources.title: A Masterclass for Releasing Karma
free_resources.description: A recorded masterclass explaining karma as a system of balance rather than punishment. She teaches a method she uses to clear self-sabotage and strengthen the spirit.
